annotations.title: How complete Homedex is in an area

description: An ESTIMATE of how much of an area's homes for sale Homedex has, and how many of the local estate agents it knows of have joined, for a town, outcode or postcode (and its local authority). Use it to say honestly how complete answers are, e.g. 'Homedex covers about 55% of homes for sale in CT20'. Always describe the figure as an estimate.
name: coverage

message.description: Set instead of areas when there are no figures yet
